meta.description: Player-level clutch differential analysis (Phase 3b Step 6). d_p = (mean Model A clutch residual) - (mean Model A regular-play residual) for players with at least 30 clutch shots. Between-player variance tau_d2 estimated via DerSimonian-Laird using binomial sampling variances.
meta.reporting_rule: Individual players are listed ONLY if the unbiased 95% interval for tau_d strictly excludes zero. Otherwise no player is named or ranked.
meta.methodological_note: Naive game-level cluster bootstrap for tau_d is strongly upward-biased (bootstrap median 7.332 pp vs observed 2.507 pp) because resampling games resamples shots within fixed players, doubling within-player binomial sampling variance while DL subtracts only one copy. Both the exact Q-profile CI [0.000, 5.444] pp and the player-level bootstrap CI [0.000, 5.112] pp include zero, agreeing with Cochran's Q = 84.64 on df = 75 (p = 0.2090).

game_bootstrap_diagnostic.naive_game_boot_bias_warning: Naive game-level bootstrap of tau_d is strongly upward-biased because resampling games resamples shots within fixed players, doubling within-player sampling variance while DerSimonian-Laird subtracts only one copy. Use the Q-profile and player-bootstrap intervals for inference on tau_d.

reporting_outcome: No player-level heterogeneity in clutch performance is detectable at this sample size (Q-profile 95% CI [0.000, 5.444] pp; player-bootstrap 95% CI [0.000, 5.112] pp; Cochran's Q = 84.64 on df = 75, p = 0.2090). Per the pre-specified reporting rule, no individual players are named or ranked.
